title: 第十二章：布置与估测
content_zh:
走在王都的街道上，苏晓留意着街道两侧的商铺，直到一家名为‘嘟噜杂货铺’的商铺出现在视线中，他的脚步停止。
这正是他要找的地方，苏晓走进这间生意萧条的杂货铺。
“咦，侍卫大人，小店三天前已经交过治安费，怎么~？”
杂货铺店长的目光仿佛在看一尊瘟神，看来平时没少被守卫队的人压榨。
“我不是来收治安费，你这里有没有这样一种植物……。”
半小时后，苏晓面带笑容的离开杂货铺，店老板热情的把他送出门，看来苏晓买了不少东西。
想要杀掉科尔波山的主人，绝不简单。
根据苏晓的记忆，那只老虎的体型，至少是普通老虎的几倍，单是高度就有四、五米左右，是一只彻头彻尾的怪兽。
苏晓没直接去野外寻找科尔波山的主人，而是先回到侍卫总部。
在侍卫总部内闲逛一会之后，苏晓来到储藏物资的仓库中。
因为欧卡的死亡，现在的侍卫队群龙无首，仅是一个上午的时间，侍卫队就隐隐有拉帮结派的趋势。
汉克与欧克的两位亲信各成一派，正在明争暗斗。
明天晚上就是焚烧废品终点站的时间，所以在今天，上面一定会选出新的侍卫首领，否则会影响大事。
在这种混乱的情况下，苏晓很轻易就潜入到仓库中，在仓库内停留一段时间后，苏晓离开了侍卫队，向科尔波山方向走去。
看着远处的城门，苏晓之前就是从这道城门潜入，而现在他想出城非常简单，只需要正大光明的向前走就可以。
那几位门卫队成员在看到苏晓后，对苏晓点头示意，直接放行，根本没去过问。
穿过城门，途径废品终点站后，苏晓看到了大片森林，这里就是科尔波山，原著主角路飞长大的地方。
走进森林，苏晓明显感觉到这里的空气更加清新，散发着各种植物的气息，一些不知名的鸟儿在树叉上叽叽咋咋叫个不停，偶尔还有一些温顺的食草类动物穿梭在植被间，并不太惧怕人类。
科尔波山虽然风景秀丽，但却也同样危险，时常有猛兽出没，一般人不敢深入内部。
走在无人的森林中，苏晓的手放在刀柄上，看似悠闲，实则却警惕着四周的风吹草动。

周围的大片密林并不适合成为苏晓的‘猎场’，他需要一片空地。
空地不需要太大，但却要满足以下两点。
第一是要有水源，哥亚王国地处海岛，缺水是海岛最常见的状况，所以科尔波山的水源也不多，只要找到水源，那找到那只巨虎的几率会增加许多。
第二是那片空地上要有植被覆盖，这样更方便他布置陷阱。
当然，苏晓布置的陷阱，绝不是挖个坑引诱科尔波山的主人掉进去。
科尔波山的土层并不算坚硬，那种体型庞大的生物，除非用水泥灌浇土坑四壁，否则一定会出现塌方现象，到时就是死路一条，想跑都跑不了。
苏晓想要的陷阱布置点，很不易寻找，但皇天不负苦心人，在苦苦寻找了三个小时后，苏晓终于找到满意的地形。
那是一片被树木环绕的空地，空地上绿草如茵，还生长着一些颜色各异的野花，散发着淡淡花香。
闻到花香后，苏晓眉头皱起，花香可能对他的计划有一定影响，但也有利有弊，花香能掩盖他布置某些物品的气味。
在储物空间中拿出一把铲子，苏晓把上衣脱下，开始在空地上挖坑~。
两小时后，苏晓藏身在空地附近的一颗大树上，那片空地看起来毫无异常，只是地面上多出几颗随意摆放的干果。
汗水顺着苏晓的脸颊滴落，他赤|膊上身后露出精壮的肌肉，他的肌肉并不夸张，显的十分平滑。
其实那些满身爆炸肌肉的壮男，并不适合战斗，强壮的肌肉的确会增强力量，但也会影响速度与柔韧性，对战斗非常不利。
苏晓曾尝试过，他找了一家很有名的拳馆，与那里最强的搏击教练切磋。
根据苏晓估测，那位全身肌肉扎结的搏击教练，力量至少是他的一倍，并且拳速非常快。
可仅过五分钟，那位据说获得过某市自由搏击冠军的搏击教练，就瘫倒在地，身体还不停抽搐，惨哼声让一些女学员心生同情。
苏晓磨炼的是杀人技巧，而那名搏击教练练习的是如何竞技，两者有本质区别。
如果定上规则，苏晓或许不是对手，但如果两人生死相搏，苏晓能在两分钟内杀掉对方。
那位搏击教练看到苏晓那一米八左右，不算强壮的体型后，说了句‘切磋就不需要规则了’，所以他注定悲剧……。
苏晓坐在一根粗壮的树上，手握【破旧的燧发枪】，这把枪还有三发子弹。

苏晓之前尝试给这把枪装弹，但轮回乐园提示，这把枪因为严重磨损，填弹可能导致整把枪破损，最后无法使用。
这大概是一种限制，因为这把枪是苏晓捡到，并不是从宝箱内获取。
在开启两枚白色宝箱后，苏晓大致了解一些轮回乐园的规则。
通过宝箱获得的物品，基本都是规则物品，可带出海贼世界，而拾取或在任务途中获得的物品，有一定几率能带出海贼世界，就比如他腰间的【斩空闪】。
通过初步摸索，苏晓得到一些结论。
生物的半数据化，只是作为一种提示，就比如他的力量从6点提升到7点这个概念，就非常直观的体现出他在变强。
至于生命值一类的东西，根本无法具体量化，最多是百分比计算，不会出现他砍出一刀，敌人掉多少滴血的情况。
敌人头顶出现的血条，更多是用来显示敌人的生命体征，血条损失的越多，就代表敌人越虚弱。
而在受到致命伤后，敌人会直接死亡，就算还剩余100%的生命值，血条也会一扫而空，之后死亡。
而装备或物品的数据化，就更加有趣。
比如他腰间的【斩龙闪】，耐久度和附加属性苏晓都能理解，而攻击力：5~16，指的是这把武器的锋利度，已经攻击强度。
装备的评分才是最重要的数据，从评分就能直观的看出物品价值。
几场战斗后苏晓明白，虽然是半数据化，但那只是为了方便估测实力，一切都是以现实为准，并没出现游戏化的情况。
半数据化是为了更加直观的体现出他的实力，已经物品的价值。
这是轮回乐园给予苏晓的最大帮助。
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
Walking on the streets of the royal capital, Su Xiao paid attention to the shops on both sides of the street, until a shop named 'Dulu Grocery Store' appeared in sight, and his footsteps stopped.
This was exactly the place he was looking for. Su Xiao walked into this sluggish grocery store.
"Hey, Sir Guard, the shop paid the security fee three days ago, what's wrong~?"
The grocery store manager's eyes seemed to be looking at a god of plague. It seemed that he was often squeezed by the guards.
"I'm not here to collect security fees. Do you have such a plant here..."
Half an hour later, Su Xiao left the grocery store with a smile on his face. The store owner enthusiastically sent him out. It seemed that Su Xiao bought a lot of things.
It is by no means easy to kill the owner of Mount Corpo.
According to Su Xiao's memory, the size of that tiger was at least several times that of an ordinary tiger. Its height alone was about four or five meters. It was a complete monster.
Su Xiao did not go directly to the wild to find the owner of Mount Kolbo, but returned to the guard headquarters first.
After wandering around the guard headquarters for a while, Su Xiao came to the warehouse where supplies were stored.
Because of Oka's death, the guards are now leaderless. In just one morning, the guards have a vague tendency to form gangs.
The two cronies of Hank and Oak are fighting openly and secretly.
Tomorrow night is the time to burn the scrap terminal, so today, the top will definitely elect a new guard leader, otherwise it will affect major events.
In this chaotic situation, Su Xiao easily sneaked into the warehouse. After staying in the warehouse for a while, Su Xiao left the guards and walked towards Mount Kolbo.
Looking at the city gate in the distance, Su Xiao had sneaked in through this gate before, but now it is very simple for him to get out of the city, he just needs to move forward openly.
After seeing Su Xiao, the members of the guard team nodded to Su Xiao and let him go without asking at all.
After passing through the city gate and passing the scrap terminal, Su Xiao saw a large forest. This is Mount Corpo, where the original protagonist Luffy grew up.
Walking into the forest, Su Xiao obviously felt that the air here was fresher, exuding the smell of various plants. Some unknown birds were chirping on the branches of the trees. Occasionally, there were some docile herbivores that shuttled among the vegetation, and were not too afraid of humans.
Although the scenery of Mount Colpo is beautiful, it is also dangerous. Wild beasts often appear, and most people dare not go deep inside.
Walking in the deserted forest, Su Xiao put her hand on the handle of the knife, seemingly leisurely, but in fact she was wary of the disturbance around her.
The large surrounding dense forest is not suitable to be Su Xiao's 'hunting ground', he needs an open space.
The open space does not need to be too large, but it must meet the following two points.
The first is to have a water source. The Kingdom of Goa is located on an island, and water shortage is the most common situation on the island. Therefore, there is not much water source in Mount Kolbo. As long as a water source is found, the chance of finding the giant tiger will increase a lot.
The second is that the open space must be covered with vegetation, which will make it easier for him to lay traps.
Of course, the trap set by Su Xiao was by no means a hole dug to lure the owner of Mount Corpo into falling.
The soil in Mount Colpo is not that hard. Unless the walls of the pit are filled with cement for such a huge creature, there will definitely be landslides. At that time, it will be a dead end and it will be impossible to escape even if it wants to.
The trap placement point that Su Xiao wanted was difficult to find, but Huangtian paid off. After three hours of searching, Su Xiao finally found a satisfactory terrain.
It was an open space surrounded by trees, with green grass and some wild flowers of different colors growing on it, exuding a faint floral fragrance.
After smelling the fragrance of flowers, Su Xiao frowned. The fragrance of flowers may have a certain impact on his plan, but it also has pros and cons. The fragrance of flowers can mask the smell of certain items he arranged.
Taking out a shovel from the storage space, Su Xiao took off her shirt, began to dig a hole in the open space~.
Two hours later, Su Xiao hid in a big tree near the clearing. The clearing looked normal, except for a few dried fruits randomly placed on the ground.
Sweat dripped down Su Xiao's cheeks, and his shirtless back revealed strong muscles. His muscles were not exaggerated and looked very smooth.
In fact, those strong men with explosive muscles are not suitable for fighting. Strong muscles will indeed increase strength, but they will also affect speed and flexibility, which is very detrimental to fighting.
Su Xiao once tried it. He found a well-known boxing gym and competed with the strongest fighting coach there.
According to Su Xiao's estimation, the fighting coach with muscles all over his body was at least twice as strong as him, and his boxing speed was very fast.
But only five minutes later, the fighting coach who was said to have won a certain city's free fighting championship collapsed to the ground, his body still twitching, and his miserable groans made some female students feel sympathy.
Su Xiao was practicing killing skills, while the fighting coach was practicing how to compete. There was an essential difference between the two.
If the rules were set, Su Xiao might not be his opponent, but if the two were fighting to the death, Su Xiao could kill each other within two minutes.
When the fighting coach saw Su Xiao's not-so-strong figure of about 1.8 meters, he said, "There is no need for rules in sparring," so he was doomed to tragedy...
Su Xiao was sitting on a thick tree, holding a [shabby flintlock gun] in his hand, which still had three bullets.
Su Xiao tried to reload the gun before, but Samsara Paradise reminded that the gun was severely worn and reloading may cause the entire gun to be damaged and ultimately unusable.
This is probably a restriction, because this gun was picked up by Su Xiao, not from the treasure chest.
After opening the two white treasure boxes, Su Xiao roughly understood some of the rules of Samsara Paradise.
Items obtained through treasure chests are basically regular items that can be taken out of the pirate world. There is a certain chance that items picked up or obtained during missions can be taken out of the pirate world, such as the [Aerial Flash] on his waist.
Through preliminary exploration, Su Xiao came to some conclusions.
The semi-digitization of creatures is just a reminder. For example, the concept of his strength increasing from 6 points to 7 points is a very intuitive reflection that he is getting stronger.
As for things like health value, it cannot be quantified specifically. At most, it is calculated as a percentage. There will be no situation where the enemy loses a few drops of blood when he cuts with a knife.
The blood bar that appears above the enemy's head is mostly used to show the enemy's vital signs. The more blood bars are lost, the weaker the enemy is.
After receiving a fatal injury, the enemy will die directly. Even if there is still 100% health left, the health bar will be wiped out and then die.
The digitization of equipment or items is even more interesting.
For example, the [Dragon Slaying Flash] on his waist has durability and additional attributes that Su Xiao can understand, and the attack power: 5~16 refers to the sharpness and attack strength of the weapon.
The rating of the equipment is the most important data. The value of the item can be intuitively seen from the rating.
After several battles, Su Xiao understood that although it was semi-digitized, it was only for the convenience of estimating strength. Everything was based on reality and there was no gamification.
Semi-digitalization is to more intuitively reflect his strength and the value of items.
This is the greatest help that Samsara Paradise has given Su Xiao.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
